content:
The **East Kanawha Lookout** is a location in The Forest region of Appalachia in *Fallout 76*.

A ranger lookout spot before the war, with a Ham Radio, map, and Ranger Outfit left behind afterward.

At the top of the tower is the corpse of a civilian who is surrounded by toys - Wooden Blocks, a Toy Alien, Toy Car, and Toy Truck. On the other side of the room, a Small Baby Bottle and Baby Rattle lie next to a clean Mattress. Near the bottom of the tower is a grave with Wooden Blocks spelling "my angel."

There is a locked Footlocker (Picklock 0) in the corner of the room. A Ranger Hat sits on top of a folding table. A ranger outfit sits on some crates on the outside of the tower as well as a map of the surrounding region. A Caps Stash may appear on some crates facing the northwest on the outside of the tower.

The East Kanawha Lookout appears in *Fallout 76*.
